text:
Sam (Partnerships): GatewayWorks says marketplace demo leads in EMEA are being routed to Redwood SDRs and they expect entitlement to follow-up. Anyone own policy?

Priya R: We default marketplace demos to Redwood SDRs for first contact. Partners can claim only with timestamped proof or if partner_referral_upload exists.

Jordan (SI Ops): For SIs providing material field support (onsite HW or engineer) propose a shorter soft-claim window (24h) and a partner_contribution flag. Otherwise 48h standard. Also add ARR override: >=300k routes to Redwood SDR.

Maya Legal: If MSAs include exclusive intro language mark contract_entitlement=true and follow MSA. All proof artifacts must be retained 12 months. I can review GatewayWorks MSA this afternoon.

Ethan L: Technical ask: require partners to submit a signed webhook when claiming: {lead_id, partner_id, timestamp, proof_url, signature}. We validate HMAC. Manual claims need a screenshot showing timestamp and partner selection.

Priya R: Ill draft Confluence schema (partner, tier, claim_window_hours, arr_override, contract_entitlement, proof_required, partner_contribution, risk_flags) and include CSV/JSON export plus example webhook.

Jordan (SI Ops): Routing pseudo-code: if lead.origin=="partner_referral_upload" && proof -> owner=partner; else if partner_contribution in ["onsite_hw","remote_engineer"] -> claim_window=24h; else claim_window=48h; if estimated_ARR>=arr_override -> owner=Redwood_SDR; if contested -> escalate to #partnerships-triage.

Sam (Partnerships): Action items: Priya create doc + templates by Fri; Jordan update SI Ops playbook; Maya check MSA; Ethan build webhook spec; Ill create #partnerships-triage and run a 30-day pilot with GatewayWorks.
